tool.name: IQ-TREE 3
tool.description: Efficient phylogenomic inference by maximum likelihood
tool.command:
## Set up prefix for output files #set $prefix = 'iqtree_output' ln -s '$alignment' ${prefix}.aln &&
iqtree -s ${prefix}.aln @THREADS@ -pre ${prefix} #if $sec_general.sequence_type and str($sec_general.sequence_type) != "" -st $sec_general.sequence_type #end if @MODEL_TOKEN@ @PARTITION_TOKEN@ @BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN@ @TREE_SEARCH_TOKEN@ @EXTRA_TREE_TOKEN@ @GENERAL_TOKEN@ #if $sec_general.pathogen --pathogen #end if #if $sec_general.pathogen_force --pathogen-force #end if #if $sec_general.tree_search_type and str($sec_general.tree_search_type) != "" --tree-search $sec_general.tree_search_type #end if #if $sec_general.alrt_pathogen --alrt $sec_general.alrt_pathogen #end if #if $sec_general.sprta --sprta #end if #if $sec_general.asr -asr #end if #if $sec_general.alninfo -alninfo #end if #if $sec_general.wsl -wsl #end if #if $sec_general.wsr -wsr #end if #if $sec_general.czb -czb #end if #if $sec_general.blmin -blmin $sec_general.blmin #end if #if $sec_general.blmax -blmax $sec_general.blmax #end if #if $sec_general.me -me $sec_general.me #end if

param.name: pathogen
param.label: Use CMAPLE pathogen tree search
param.help: Apply CMAPLE tree search if sequence divergence is low, otherwise use IQ-TREE algorithm

param.name: pathogen_force
param.label: Force CMAPLE pathogen tree search
param.help: Apply CMAPLE tree search regardless of sequence divergence

param.name: tree_search_type
param.label: Tree search type (CMAPLE)
param.help: Only effective with pathogen mode
param.option: FAST - placement only, no SPR moves
NORMAL - SPR moves at newly-added nodes only
EXHAUSTIVE - SPR moves at all nodes

param.name: alrt_pathogen
param.label: SH-aLRT replicates (pathogen mode)
param.help: Number of replicates for SH-aLRT in CMAPLE pathogen mode

param.name: sprta
param.label: Compute SPRTA branch supports
param.help: Compute SPRTA branch supports (pathogen mode)

param.name: asr
param.label: Ancestral sequence reconstruction
param.help: Write ancestral sequences for all tree nodes to .state file

param.name: alninfo
param.label: Print alignment site statistics
param.help: Write alignment site statistics to .alninfo file

param.name: wsl
param.label: Write site log-likelihoods
param.help: Write site log-likelihoods to .sitelh file

param.name: wsr
param.label: Write per-site rates
param.help: Write per-site rates to .rate file

param.name: czb
param.label: Collapse near-zero branches
param.help: Collapse near-zero branches so the final tree may be multifurcating

param.name: blmin
param.label: Minimum branch length
param.help: DEFAULT: the smaller of 0.000001 and 0.1/alignment_length

param.name: blmax
param.label: Maximum branch length
param.help: DEFAULT: 10

param.name: me
param.label: Log-likelihood epsilon
param.help: Epsilon for final model parameter estimation. DEFAULT: 0.01 (0.05 with -fast)

param.name: mset
param.label: Restrict model set
param.help: Comma-separated list of base models (e.g. WAG,LG,JTT) or program name (raxml, phyml, mrbayes)

param.name: mrate
param.label: Rate heterogeneity types
param.help: Comma-separated list (e.g. E,I,G,I+G or E,I,G,I+G,R)

param.name: mfreq
param.label: Frequency types
param.help: Comma-separated list of frequency types for model selection

param.name: cmin
param.label: Min FreeRate categories
param.help: Minimum number of categories for FreeRate model. DEFAULT: 2

param.name: cmax
param.label: Max FreeRate categories
param.help: Maximum number of categories for FreeRate model. DEFAULT: 10

param.name: mtree
param.label: Full tree search for each model
param.help: Turn on full tree search for each model considered. More accurate but slower

param.name: rcluster
param.label: Relaxed clustering percentage
param.help: Percentage for relaxed clustering algorithm (e.g. 10 for top 10%)

param.name: rclusterf
param.label: Fast relaxed clustering percentage
param.help: Percentage for fast relaxed clustering algorithm

param.name: partition_file
param.label: Partition file
param.help: Partition file in NEXUS or RAxML-style format

param.name: partition_type
param.label: Partition model type
param.help: -q: edge-equal, -spp: edge-proportional, -sp: edge-unlinked
param.option: Edge-unlinked (each partition has own branch lengths)

param.name: bsam
param.label: Bootstrap resampling strategy
param.help: Resampling strategy for partitioned analysis

param.name: abayes
param.label: Approximate Bayes test
param.help: Perform approximate Bayes test for branch support

param.name: lbp
param.label: Local bootstrap probability replicates
param.help: Number of replicates (>=1000) for fast local bootstrap probability method

param.name: starting_tree
param.label: Starting tree
param.help: File containing starting tree for tree search

param.name: fixed_tree
param.label: Fixed user tree
param.help: Fix user tree - no tree search is performed, only log-likelihood is computed

param.name: constraint_tree
param.label: Constraint tree
param.help: Topological constraint tree file in NEWICK format. Can be multifurcating and need not include all taxa

param.name: outgroup
param.label: Outgroup taxon
param.help: Specify an outgroup taxon name to root the tree

tool.help:
# IQ-TREE 3: Phylogenomic Inference
IQ-TREE 3 is software for phylogenomic inference using maximum likelihood and complex evolutionary models. It can be used for:
- **Tree reconstruction** under maximum likelihood - **Model selection** via ModelFinder (automatically finding the best-fit substitution model) - **Branch support** via ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot), SH-aLRT, nonparametric bootstrap, and more - **Partitioned analysis** for multi-gene phylogenomic datasets - **Pathogen analysis** via the integrated CMAPLE algorithm for low-divergence sequences - **Ancestral sequence reconstruction**
## Key features
### Model selection IQ-TREE's ModelFinder automatically selects the best-fit substitution model for your data. Use **MFP** (ModelFinder Plus) for the recommended extended model selection that includes FreeRate models, or **TEST** for standard model selection.
### Branch support - **Ultrafast bootstrap (UFBoot)**: `-bb` with >=1000 replicates. Fast approximation of bootstrap support. - **SH-aLRT**: `-alrt` with >=1000 replicates. Fast single-branch test. - **Nonparametric bootstrap**: `-b` with >=100 replicates. Standard but slower bootstrap. - These can be combined in a single run.
### Partition models For multi-gene datasets, provide a partition file (NEXUS or RAxML format) and choose the partition model type: - **Edge-equal** (`-q`): all partitions share the same branch lengths - **Edge-proportional** (`-spp`): partitions have different evolutionary speeds - **Edge-unlinked** (`-sp`): each partition has its own branch lengths
### Pathogen mode For pathogen data (e.g., SARS-CoV-2), IQ-TREE 3 integrates CMAPLE for efficient tree search on low-divergence alignments. Enable with `--pathogen` (auto-detect) or `--pathogen-force` (always use CMAPLE).
## Output files
- **`.treefile`**: Best ML tree in NEWICK format - **`.log`**: Full log of the analysis - **`.iqtree`**: Human-readable report with full results - **`.contree`**: Consensus tree (if bootstrap used) - **`.state`**: Ancestral sequences (if `-asr` used) - **`.alninfo`**: Alignment site statistics (if `-alninfo` used) - **`.sitelh`**: Site log-likelihoods (if `-wsl` used) - **`.rate`**: Per-site rates (if `-wsr` used)
## Documentation
Full documentation is available at the [IQ-TREE website](https://iqtree.github.io/doc/).
